risks.title: Loss of Israeli Tax Benefits
risks.score_rationale: Risk positioned at the beginning of Item 1A with material impact language ('adversely affect our business, financial condition'). Increased trend: legislation modified in 2011 reducing rates from 16% to 12%, creating dependence on fragile statuses. Regulatory category = strong weight. Direct financial impact on profitability.

risks.title: Estimation of Future Costs in Revenue Recognition
risks.score_rationale: Identified as 'Critical Audit Matter' in audit report, indicating complexity and significant judgment. High-intensity language: 'significant judgment', 'complex', 'challenging'. Represents $216.7M of product revenues (22% of total). Stable but structural trend. Strong weight due to direct impact on financial statements.

risks.title: Debt Levels and Complex Financing Structure
risks.score_rationale: Balance sheet shows total debt of $2.4B (long-term + short-term debt) versus equity of $2.7B (ratio 0.89). Presence of non-recourse debt (VIEs), convertible notes and asset retirement obligations. Increased trend: short-term debt increases $80M (2024 to 2025). Capital category = strong weight for viability.

risks.title: Dependence on Long-Term Contracts and Execution Risks
risks.score_rationale: Majority of $216.7M product revenues derive from long-term contracts. Critical audit highlights technical execution and project management risks. Moderate language ('may affect') but structural impact. Stable trend. Medium-strong weight as it affects product gross margin (78.7% of costs).

risks.title: Risks Related to Variable Interest Entities (VIEs)
risks.score_rationale: VIEs represent $3.5B in assets (56% of total) and $725M in non-recourse debt. Balance sheet shows structural dependence on VIEs for geothermal project financing. Increased trend: construction-in-progress related to VIEs increases $141M. Regulatory and accounting consolidation risk.

risks.title: Dependence on Tax Benefits Sale Revenues
risks.score_rationale: Tax benefits sale revenues: $66.7M in 2025 (51% of operating income before taxes). Moderate language but material impact on net profitability. Stable trend but vulnerable to Israeli legislative changes. Regulatory category = strong weight.
